notes: A 100 Series lawn tractor. Part numbers are from Deere's March 2023 replacement parts guide (E100, and E100 with the 42 inch convertible deck); engine, starter, charging, tank and transmission details are TractorData's, which gives production years 2018 to 2020.

gaps: The parts guide lists parts only: no engine model, battery CCA, starter, fuel tank, solenoid, bearing or safety switch appears on it, so those come from TractorData or are left out.
TractorData's 300 CCA battery rating is not claimed; the guide does not show it.
TractorSpecs (tractortechspecs.com) shows the same figures as TractorData and adds the engine name Intek, but it names no source for its data, so it is not cited and the Intek name is left out.

The 9 A charging figure rests on TractorData alone (it cites Deere operator's manuals for the E100); a search summary mentioned a Briggs & Stratton engine page giving a lower charging figure, but that page returned HTTP 429 and was not read.
Quantities of the blade and the transmission are not stated in the sources and are left out; the guide does not say how many blades the deck takes.
Production years 2018-2020 are TractorData's; the parts guide is dated March 2023 and may cover later units.
method: Replacement parts guide PDF (deere.com, GX572025 and GX573839, March 2023): page 1 E100 100 Series Tractor (oil, battery, headlight bulb, ignition switch, traction drive belt); page 2 E100 with 42 inch convertible deck (blade, V-belt). Read as text with part numbers compared character by character.
TractorData E100 page (spec database that cites Deere operator's manuals OMUC17903, OMUC20527 and OMUC23650): production years, charging amps, fuel tank, battery volts.
TractorData E100 engine page: Briggs & Stratton 31R977, displacement, power, electric 12 V starter.
TractorData E100 transmission page: General Transmission RT400, belt-driven CVT.
Deere's E100 product page (deere.ca) and operator's manual IDs on techpubs.deere.com returned nothing usable to the researcher and are not cited.

comps.spec: Briggs & Stratton 31R977 engine (TractorData): one cylinder, vertical shaft, 500 cc (30.52 cu in), 17.5 hp (13.0 kW) gross power
12 V battery, Deere part TY25221B (for Canada and USA); Deere part MCYP340PF (12 V) is listed for other markets

Two belts in the guide: traction drive belt GX24154 (length 2492 mm, thickness 8.89 mm, width 12.7 mm; page 1) and V-belt UC32283 (length 2635 mm, thickness 10.9 mm, width 14.4 mm) listed with the 42 inch convertible deck (page 2)
Transmission: General Transmission RT400, belt-driven continuously variable (CVT), infinite forward and reverse gears (TractorData)
Headlight bulb, Deere part AD2062R, 27 W
Mower blade, Deere part UC21583, listed with the 42 inch convertible deck; mulch blade AM141033 is also listed (guide page 2)
